controls.source_trace: Requirement/product behavior -> trusted authority -> enforced invariant.
controls.controlled_verification: Establish the intended rule with owner evidence before probing a synthetic workflow.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Undocumented assumptions stay questions; ordinary discount behavior may be intended.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Accepted security invariant is explicit and enforced at the authoritative boundary.

controls.source_trace: Persistent state -> permitted transition -> actor -> side-effect commit.
controls.controlled_verification: Skip/reorder one controlled step and inspect authoritative state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: UI navigation is not a state machine; status alone does not show commit outcome.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Invalid/repeated transitions leave state/effects unchanged; valid paths still complete.

controls.source_trace: Read eligibility -> reservation/uniqueness -> committed benefit -> queue.
controls.controlled_verification: Use bounded approved attempts or deterministic local interleaving.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: One non-reproducing race attempt is inconclusive; process locks are not distributed guarantees.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Exactly one committed result under the relevant cross-worker concurrency model.

controls.source_trace: Caller assertion -> server-calculated value -> authorization -> commit.
controls.controlled_verification: Use tiny synthetic amounts/entitlements and independent owner-side readback.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Legitimate delegated calculation is not automatically untrusted.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Trusted values are reconciled at commit and cannot be overridden through alternate channels.

controls.source_trace: API/webhook/job -> operation identity -> state transition -> deduplication.
controls.controlled_verification: Replay an agreed one-time fixture through each relevant entry point.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Replay may be valid for idempotent reads; identify the business contract.
controls.remediation_acceptance: All channels enforce the same invariant and stable operation identity.

controls.source_trace: Actor -> expensive capability -> quota/admission -> durable resource.
controls.controlled_verification: Review budgets or use bounded local cost instrumentation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Do not exhaust live inventory, money or service capacity to prove impact.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Admission/accounting limits protect intended resources without breaking legitimate usage.
